text:
deploy-bot: config-only push requested by @nina for change window 03:00-04:00 UTC. Changes: reduce batching.window, add soft throttle, tweak routing spill threshold. plan: 1% isolation-canary for 20m -> hold; pin model rwd-stable-2026. dry-run ok. runbook: https://go/runbooks/config-isolation-canary :robot_face:
nina: diff (yaml) pasted below. aiming minimal surface area but two knobs so we'll be conservative.
```
service:
  batching:
    window_ms: 45
  routing:
    spill_threshold: 0.12
  limits:
    soft_throttle_rps: 140
```
sam: please pin model variant rwd-stable-2026 and add obs for prefetch_cache_miss, burst_queue_depth, and 429-rate. ops_lee will run preflight at 02:30 UTC.
ops_lee: preflight OK at 02:34 UTC. smoke: curl -H "x-tenant: smoke-b" https://api.redwood/v1/infer -> 200, p95 54ms. creating alerts ALRT-6001 (prefetch miss), ALRT-6002 (burst queue), ALRT-6003 (5xx).
deploy-bot: starting isolation canary id=cfg-iso-283333, percent=1, hold_after=20m, pinned_model=rwd-stable-2026
monitoring-bot: t+6m: p95 +2ms, prefetch_cache_miss +0.8%, no alerts.
monitoring-bot: t+12m: p95 +6ms, burst_queue_depth +2, all below thresholds.
monitoring-bot: t+18m: prefetch_cache_miss jumps to +6%, 429-rate 0.7% -> ALRT-6001 fires.
nina: seeing ALRT-6001. traces show increased backend fetches for small-tenant traffic causing elevated latency. recommend abort, rollback. ops_lee, confirm?
ops_lee: agree. aborting canary. @deploy-bot rollback cfg-iso-283333
deploy-bot: rollback in progress. previous config restored. ETA ~90s.
monitoring-bot: post-rollback t+3m: metrics normalized, prefetch miss back to baseline, 429-rate <0.05%. alerts cleared.
sam: root-cause: reduced batching.window lowered local KV prefetch effectiveness; combined with slightly lower spill_threshold caused more route spill to slow backend. plan: split changes: (A) batching.window alone in daytime 2% canary, (B) spill_threshold+soft_throttle in separate follow-up with staged capacity tests. keep pin for both.
nina: will open PRs PR-20021 (batching-only) and PR-20022 (routing+throttle). schedule batching-only for tomorrow 10:00-11:00 UTC with 2% canary. ops_lee, please expand preflight to include synthetic small-tenant patterns.
ops_lee: noted. will also add a short safety: automatic abort if prefetch_cache_miss >3% or 429-rate >0.3% during canary.
sam: thanks. closing thread; waiting on PRs and reschedule. :white_check_mark:
